title: Public healthcare: entitlement first, health card second
intro: Use this guide to separate two steps that are often confused: Spain-wide healthcare entitlement and the regional health card that gives you practical access to your autonomous community's health service. In the Valencian Community, that regional card is the SIP card.
status: National entitlement + regional card · SIP is specific to the Valencian Community

items.label: Procedure
items.text: First confirm whether your public healthcare entitlement is already recognized in Spain. If recognition is needed, use the Social Security healthcare-entitlement procedure. In the Valencian Community, then register or reactivate yourself in the Sistema de Información Poblacional (SIP) using Generalitat procedure GVA 21561.

items.label: Where to go
items.text: Healthcare entitlement is handled through the national Social Security system/INSS. Valencian SIP registration is filed with the Generalitat Valenciana; after the electronic request, you go to the health centre assigned to your address to collect the card or inclusion document.

items.label: What to select
items.text: If Social Security already shows your healthcare right, move on to the regional card step. In Valencia choose 'Alta de un ciudadano en el Sistema de Información Poblacional (SIP)' — GVA 21561. Do not use the lost/damaged-card renewal procedure for a first registration.

items.label: Forms and fee
items.text: The initial Valencian SIP registration is an electronic procedure and carries no fee. If healthcare entitlement itself still needs recognition, use the INSS online service or the official healthcare-entitlement application route before relying on the regional card step.

items.label: Prepare
bullets: Identity details and your DNI/NIE or other accepted identity document for your case
Your current address in the Valencian Community
Padrón evidence if the administration cannot verify it electronically or you oppose the electronic check
Any Social Security or healthcare-entitlement evidence relevant to your coverage situation
A supported electronic identification/signature method for the Generalitat online filing
Identification when you attend your assigned health centre to collect the card or inclusion document

items.label: What happens after
items.text: The Valencian electronic SIP request is designed for an immediate response, followed by an in-person visit to the assigned health centre for collection. SIP records your identification, address and healthcare-coverage status; it does not replace the national decision on entitlement when that decision is required.
